$comment: VerseKit plugin registry. Each plugin is published as a zip (PluginName/PluginName.dll + deps) on a 'plugins-v*' GitHub release. The app reads this from the raw URL on the default branch.

plugins.name: Resource Manager
plugins.description: View, create, and update web resources in your Dynamics 365 environment, and review your changes before saving.
plugins.author: VerseKit

plugins.name: Table Browser
plugins.description: Browse tables (entities) with their columns, relationships and alternate keys — read only.
plugins.author: VerseKit

plugins.name: Security Roles
plugins.description: Browse security roles, see which users and teams hold each, and compare two roles — read only.
plugins.author: VerseKit

plugins.name: Access Checker
plugins.description: See a user's effective table privileges across all their roles and teams, which role grants each, and compare two users — read only.
plugins.author: VerseKit

plugins.name: Solution Explorer
plugins.description: Browse solutions, see their components, check for missing dependencies, and export managed/unmanaged to disk.
plugins.author: VerseKit

plugins.name: Query Runner
plugins.description: Run FetchXML or OData queries with history and saved queries, view results in a grid, and export to CSV/Excel — read only.
plugins.author: VerseKit

plugins.name: Dependency Viewer
plugins.description: See what depends on a table or column before deleting it — read only.
plugins.author: VerseKit

plugins.name: Flow Runs
plugins.description: View and export cloud flow run history (succeeded, failed, cancelled) from Dataverse, and open runs in Power Automate — read only.
plugins.author: VerseKit
